from omegaconf import OmegaConf
from pocket_coffea.parameters import defaults

# Step 1: Fetch the framework's default parameter set
params = OmegaConf.create(defaults)

# Step 2: Load YAML override files and merge them onto defaults
preselection = OmegaConf.load("params/object_preselection.yaml")
triggers = OmegaConf.load("params/triggers.yaml")

# Merge with file values overriding defaults (later configs take precedence)
params = OmegaConf.merge(params, preselection, triggers)
